Repeated roll numbers

Schools where the same roll number was assessed more than once (across all forms for that school). Each repeat inflates the student count — Unique roll nos is the likelier number of children assessed. Ask the CRCC whether it was a double submission, a re-test, or roll numbers restarting in a second form.

Data: school directory from the Koraput NV Phase I list (201 schools) and NV 2 selected-school list (348 schools), merged by UDISE code; pilot cohort from the 100 Schools for September PA list; assessment results from PARAKH 2027 Grade 2 baseline, Koraput rows only, from the state's 8 October correct- and incorrect-data files (5254 records from 497 schools). Learning results use only the 4562 correct records; schools whose data was marked incorrect count as visited but are left out of the scores until they are re-assessed.
